title: ChronoGraph: Functional 4D Scene Graphs with Vision-Language Models for Interaction Understanding and Grounded Planning
abstract: arXiv:2609.39665v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Embodied agents must determine where to act, anticipate the resulting scene changes, and interpret observed outcomes to guide subsequent actions. This requires connecting 4D interaction understanding, which explains how past actions changed the scene, with spatially grounded planning, which determines how and where to act toward a goal and anticipates the resulting scene changes. We introduce ChronoGraph, a functional 4D scene graph that links actions on affordance parts to semantic and geometric state changes. By representing observed and anticipated transitions in the same form, it provides a shared basis for understanding and planning. We construct ChronoGraphBench through an automatic data engine that converts human-interaction videos and simulated robot trajectories into graph-annotated questions for training and evaluating Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on both tasks. translated_title: ChronoGraph：基于视觉-语言模型的功能性4D场景图，用于交互理解与落地规划
translated_abstract: 具身智能体必须确定在哪里行动、预测由此产生的场景变化，并解释观察到的结果以指导后续行动。这需要将4D交互理解（即解释过去的动作如何改变了场景）与空间落地规划（即确定如何以及在哪里朝目标行动并预测由此产生的场景变化）联系起来。我们提出了ChronoGraph，一种功能性4D场景图，它将操作可供性部件（affordance parts）上的动作与语义和几何状态变化相联系。通过以相同形式表示观察到的和预期的状态转移，它为理解与规划提供了共同基础。我们通过一个自动数据引擎构建了ChronoGraphBench，将人类交互视频和模拟机器人轨迹转换为带图标注的问题，用于训练和评估视觉-语言模型（VLM）在这两项任务上的表现。利用这些标注，我们通过适配预训练的VLM训练了ChronoGraphVLM。
tldr: ChronoGraph提出一种将动作与语义、几何状态变化统一表示的功能性4D场景图，并配套自动构建的ChronoGraphBench基准与ChronoGraphVLM模型，使视觉-语言模型能够同时完成交互理解与空间落地规划。
en_tdlr: ChronoGraph introduces a functional 4D scene graph that uniformly represents actions and their semantic-geometric state changes, and along with the automatically built ChronoGraphBench and ChronoGraphVLM, enables vision-language models to jointly perform interaction understanding and spatially grounded planning.
